---

description: Rebuild the context bundle and run every check

---

1. Run `node tools/build-context.js` in the terminal and show the line it prints.

2. Run `node tools/validate.js` and wait for it to finish (about 2 minutes).

3. Do not change any file.

4. Reply with a table: section, checks, passed. Then one line: the last line the validator printed.

   If anything failed, quote the failing lines exactly and stop.
